1.1.0.en: Lower memory use and less work per event: bounded user cache, no leaked sockets or timers on reconnect, and background events are now filtered before any lookup. Events carry BioStar 2's own timestamp and always reach Flows in order. New: open a door from a Flow, filter triggers by reader, force reconnect and tune the ignore lists from Settings, live counters, and a warning when the BioStar 2 account lacks permissions. Adds an option to hide user names from the activity log.
